title: Set 129

sentences.ko: 이모들이 하나같이 집은 언제 살 거냐고 물어봐서, 계속 알아보는 중이라고 했는데 사실 알아보지도 않아. 내년엔 그냥 샀다고 말할까 봐. 그러면 적어도 다른 걸 물어볼 테니까.
sentences.text: Every single aunt asked me when I'm going to buy a house, and I kept saying I'm looking, which isn't even true. I think next year I'm just going to tell them I bought one, because at least then they'd ask me something else.

alts.text: All my aunts kept asking when I'm gonna buy a house, and I kept saying I'm looking, which isn't even true. Next year I'm just gonna say I bought one, so at least they'll ask about something else.

Each of my aunts asked me when I intend to purchase a house, and I continued to say that I am looking, which is not actually true. Next year, I believe I will simply tell them that I have bought one, because then they would at least ask me about something else.

sentences.note: **Every single** 는 every 를 세게 말하는 표현으로, 하나도 빠짐없이 전부라는 느낌입니다. **I'm looking** 은 여기서 집을 알아보는 중이라는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 친척들 모인 자리에서 질문 공세 받은 얘기

sentences.ko: 그래서 네 생각엔 내가 걔한테 말해야 할 것 같아, 아니면 괜히 더 꼬일까? 왜냐면 걔가 이미 알고 있을 것 같기도 하거든. 알고 있으면 내가 그 얘기를 꺼내는 게 좀 의미가 없잖아. 모르겠다. 하룻밤 생각해 보고 내일 전화할게.
sentences.text: So do you think I should tell her, or would that just make it worse? Because part of me thinks she already knows, and if she does, then me bringing it up is kind of pointless. I don't know. Let me sleep on it and I'll call you tomorrow.

alts.text: Think I should tell her, or would that just make it worse? Part of me figures she already knows, and if she does, there's no point bringing it up. I dunno. Lemme sleep on it, I'll call you tomorrow.

Do you believe I should tell her, or would that only make the situation worse? Part of me suspects that she already knows, and if that is the case, raising the subject would be rather pointless. I am not certain. Allow me to think it over tonight, and I will call you tomorrow.

sentences.note: **sleep on it** 은 바로 정하지 않고 하룻밤 자면서 생각해 보겠다는 말입니다. **bringing it up** 은 어떤 이야기를 꺼낸다는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 친구한테 고민 상담하면서 결론은 못 내리기

sentences.ko: 회사에 어떤 사람이 있는데 뭐든 다 전체 답장을 해. 고맙다는 말 한마디도 전체 답장으로 해서, 나랑 상관도 없는 메일이 하루에 한 사십 통은 와. 근데 나는 뭐라고 할 수도 없어. 그 사람이 상사가 아끼는 사람이라 괜히 나만 안 좋게 보일 거거든.
sentences.text: There's this guy at work who hits reply all on everything, even when it's just to say thanks, so I get like forty emails a day that have nothing to do with me. And I can't say anything, because he's the boss's favorite and I'd be the one who looks bad.

alts.text: Some guy at work hits reply all on literally everything, even just to say thanks, so I get like forty emails a day that aren't about me at all. And I can't say anything, since he's the boss's favorite and I'd end up looking bad.

One of my colleagues uses reply all on every message, even when he is only saying thank you, so I receive approximately forty emails a day that are unrelated to me. I am unable to say anything, because he is the manager's favorite, and I would be the one who would look bad.

sentences.note: **hits reply all** 은 이메일에서 전체 답장을 누른다는 뜻입니다. **have nothing to do with me** 는 나랑 아무 상관 없다는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: 회사 사람 때문에 짜증난 걸 친구한테 털어놓기

sentences.ko: 우리 개가 문 옆에 앉아서 나를 빤히 쳐다보면 내가 미안해서 데리고 나간다는 걸 알아 버렸어. 방금 산책하고 들어왔어도 말이야. 날 갖고 노는 거 아는데 매번 넘어가. 혹시 이번엔 진짜 급한 거면 어떡해?
sentences.text: My dog's figured out that if he sits by the door and stares at me, I'll feel guilty and take him out, even if we just got back. I know he's playing me, but I fall for it every time, because what if this is the one time he really has to go?

alts.text: He's got me figured out, my dog. He sits by the door and stares till I feel guilty and take him out, even if we just got back. I know he's playing me, but I fall for it every time. What if this time he really has to go?

My dog has learned that if he sits by the door and looks at me, I will feel guilty and take him outside, even if we have only just returned. I am aware that he is manipulating me, but I give in every time, because what if this is the one occasion on which he genuinely needs to go?

sentences.note: **playing me** 는 나를 갖고 논다, 이용한다는 뜻입니다. **fall for it** 은 속아 넘어간다는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 치킨 샌드위치 하나 시켰는데 누구네 집 저녁 한 상을 통째로 갖다줬어. 큰 용기 네 개에 샐러드까지. 가게에 전화했더니 그냥 드시라고 해서, 일주일 내내 태국 음식 먹게 생겼어. 근데 내 샌드위치는 끝내 못 받았어.
sentences.text: I ordered one chicken sandwich and they brought me somebody's whole family dinner, like four big containers and a salad. I called the restaurant, and they said just keep it, so I guess we're eating Thai food all week. I never got my sandwich, though.

alts.text: So I order one chicken sandwich, right? And they bring me some family's whole dinner, like four big containers and a salad. Called the place, they said just keep it, so I guess it's Thai all week. Never got my sandwich, though.

I ordered a single chicken sandwich, and they delivered an entire family dinner intended for someone else, consisting of four large containers and a salad. When I called the restaurant, they told me to keep it, so it appears we will be eating Thai food for the entire week. However, I never received my sandwich.

sentences.note: **I guess** 는 그런가 보다, 그렇게 됐네 하는 체념 섞인 말입니다. 끝에 붙는 **though** 는 그래도, 근데 라는 뜻으로 앞 말에 반전을 더합니다.
sentences.situation: 배달 시켰는데 엉뚱한 게 와서 얘기하기
